briefdescription.para: Enhanced Inference Engine for Converged Storage-Inference.

detaileddescription.para:
Provides LLM inference capabilities integrated with:
ContinuousBatchScheduler for request scheduling
PagedKVCache for KV state management
LoRA adapter support for domain-specific fine-tuning
Speculative decoding support
Streaming generation support
This engine is designed for per-shard inference in a converged storage-retrieval-inference architecture.
